subject: Mental Models
title: Platform Strategy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Platform Strategy.

hook.text: Uber owns no cars. Airbnb owns no hotels.

buildup.text: A platform connects producers and consumers, capturing value from each transaction without owning the underlying assets.

discovery.text: Marshall Van Alstyne showed that platforms scale faster than traditional businesses because adding users costs nearly.

twist.text: Platforms face the chicken-and-egg problem. Sellers need buyers and buyers need sellers.

climax.text: If you are building a marketplace, solve one side's problem first to attract them.

punchline.text: Connect buyers and sellers. Own the platform, not the assets.

quiz.question: What is the chicken-and-egg problem in platform strategy?
options: Platforms are too expensive to build
Both sides need each other before either will join
Users prefer physical products over digital ones
